floorPlans.note: Areas describe the illustrated layouts. Confirm the signed plan, area and plot for the specific villa.

review.images: The villa launch supplies the Ravenna poolside hero and kitchen. The developer brochure supplies two Cassia elevations, a villa bedroom and a clearly labelled community pavilion. The distinct apartment and mansion releases were excluded.
review.location: The Aldar brochure map on physical page 6 shows the community beside Al Barari and E311. The 25-minute values are from the separate Jiwak-hosted Aldar Cassia fact sheet and are scoped to that release. Aldar also lists the same area estimates on its Wilds Residences launch. No exact gate was verified.
review.floorPlans: Reviewed the complete 11-page OPR-hosted Aldar villa PDF. Eight plan spreads on pages 2–7 and 9–10 show Cassia and Ravenna layouts and print gross saleable areas. The other pages are cover or chapter art.

unavailable: Verified villa cluster entrance coordinates and plot-specific signed dimensions.
